name: ns-derivation-in
description: An input frame carries the core's send-time stamp — the corpus assigns no clock to input, this tag does — and is derived exactly as output is: 1789000001.000000999 s becomes sec 1789000001, usec 0. Operator input is recorded verbatim (open_decisions §5), in the same recording as the output. The two directions are stamped by two clocks, so a reader never assumes timestamps increase across directions.
